description: This file is a shell script for testing git remote group handling, including setup, updates, and error scenarios for repositories and remotes.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Writes a string to a file named 'mark' to mark a step in the test.

methods.name: update_repo
methods.description: Updates a repository by adding a file 'file', committing with a message from 'mark'.

methods.name: repo_fetched
methods.description: Checks if the latest commit message matches 'mark' to determine if the repo was fetched.
